usage: deskops add role [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                        [--name NAME] [--description DESCRIPTION]
                        [--kind KIND] [--model MODEL]
                        [--fallback-models FALLBACK_MODELS [FALLBACK_MODELS ...]]
                        [--tools TOOLS [TOOLS ...]]
                        [--system-prompt-mode SYSTEM_PROMPT_MODE]
                        [--inherit-project-context INHERIT_PROJECT_CONTEXT]
                        [--inherit-skills INHERIT_SKILLS]
                        [--default-context DEFAULT_CONTEXT] [--body BODY]

Create a role artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the role payload from a YAML file.
  --name NAME           Installed pi-agent role name, such as 'deskops-
                        supervisor'.
  --description DESCRIPTION
                        Short description of when to use this role prompt.
  --kind KIND           Agent runtime kind (e.g. pi, claude, opencode).
  --model MODEL         Primary model ID.
  --fallback-models FALLBACK_MODELS [FALLBACK_MODELS ...]
                        Fallback models.
  --tools TOOLS [TOOLS ...]
                        Enabled tools.
  --system-prompt-mode SYSTEM_PROMPT_MODE
                        System prompt mode.
  --inherit-project-context INHERIT_PROJECT_CONTEXT
                        Inherit project context.
  --inherit-skills INHERIT_SKILLS
                        Inherit project skills.
  --default-context DEFAULT_CONTEXT
                        Default context type (e.g. fork).
  --body BODY           Full role prompt markdown body after the YAML
                        frontmatter.

Example:
  deskops add role --root . --name "example" --description "..." --body "..."
